text: Working with APIs is an important skill for modern developers. An API allows two programs to communicate with each other. Usually, your application sends an HTTP request to a server, and the server sends back data, often in JSON format. Before you can use many APIs, you need authentication, such as an API key, to prove who you are. It is also important to respect rate limits, which control how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, good error handling helps your app respond properly when something goes wrong, such as a failed request or an invalid response.
